06 / ABOUT ME

Hi, I’m Sydney.

Creative thinker. Brand-minded marketer. Always paying attention to what people actually care about.

I’m Sydney Collier, an LSU business student with a concentration in Digital Marketing. I’m interested in the space where brand, culture, content and consumer behavior all meet — figuring out what makes someone stop scrolling, remember a campaign, connect with a brand or choose one product over another.

My experience has given me the chance to work across brand strategy, social media, content creation, campaign development, web design, audience research, analytics and paid media. I’ve worked on projects in healthcare, beauty, retail and professional services, and I’ve also built my own TikTok community of 19K+ followers.

I like creative work, but I also like understanding the why behind it. I use audience insights, trends and performance data to make stronger creative decisions. That’s why I’m especially drawn to roles in brand marketing, social media, content and creative strategy — particularly with consumer-facing brands in beauty, fashion, lifestyle, entertainment and sports.

Whether I’m building a website, shaping a campaign idea, creating social content or turning research into a brand recommendation, I want the final work to feel current, intentional and made for real people.
